scenes.motion_prompt: The same 2D illustrated character Bobo sits wrapped snugly in his blanket on the balcony, slowly lifting the warm mug to take a small sip, then holding it in both hands again. Steam gently rises from the mug. A new shooting star streaks softly across the night sky and he tilts his head slightly to follow it, eyes calm and half-lidded, a small peaceful huff escaping him, almost a tiny smile. The string lights flicker gently and sway in a light breeze, the lantern flame flickers warmly. Cozy, quiet, healing late-night mood, slow gentle motion, no glitches, consistent character and art style.
